notes.title: Deck Adventurers: Origins will be present at the next Turn-Based Carnival
notes.content:
Thanks to Acram Digital, the next Turn-Based Carnival will be held on Steam from November 13, and until November 20 you can enjoy a lot of turn-based strategy games, such as Deck Adventurers: Origins.

Don't miss it! We've already seen some of the selected ones, and they look great!

notes.title: Reduced difficulty in siege of Grimel
notes.content:
The last part of the game (the siege of Grimel) has a very high difficulty. One of the biggest handicaps for some players is the fact that the characters do not recover their health at the end of the combat, but they need to rest (and change character) to do it. But it could happen that both main characters finish a combat with very few health points, which made the next one very difficult.

With this update, characters recover up to 66% of their maximum health after each combat, so you will never find yourself in such a desperate situation.

Will you now be able to reach the end of the game?

notes.title: Deck Adventurers Origins will have a sequel
notes.content:
It's official: Deck Adventurers Heroes of the Valley will be the continuation of Deck Adventurers Origins, and will be available, foreseeably, at the end of 2021.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682240?utm_source=stm_da-or_upd1

The main news is an important change in the combat system, since the characters will now fight on a grid, turning Deck Adventurers into an interesting hybrid of tactical turn-based combat, while preserving its essence of a card and deck building game.

Also, the story will continue right at the point where its predecessor ends, so if you haven't already: Let's go! Complete Deck Adventurers Origins!
